evidence.claim: The trial read the human-owner intent reference and related routing/spec files, but its reported exact owner was instead production code.
Read-only verification confirmed the candidate-generation config factory and shared setup_target lifecycle owners, plus a clean checkout.

The proposal should have remained explicitly proposed without assigning the production implementation owner as the routing decision.
